name: Emanuel Cleaver
stance: Rejects AI industry self-policing and calls for immediate congressional guardrails, citing industry warnings of extraordinary damage.

statements.text: Even leaders in the AI industry have acknowledged the technology’s potential to do extraordinary damage to society if left unchecked.
“Self-policing” is not acceptable. Republicans must work with Democrats to enact guardrails that will protect our communities.
The president continues to make clear that Republicans will do nothing to regulate AI, hold Silicon Valley billionaires accountable, or put our communities before Big Tech corporate profits.
